HowMaHiCo 0.0.0.9000

CLAUDE.md — HowMaHiCo

Source: CLAUDE.md

What this is

An LC-immunopeptidomics (MHC/HLA peptide) data-analysis project: a parameterized RMarkdown reporting pipeline that ingests LC-MS search-engine output (FragPipe, DIA-NN, PEAKS), normalizes it into one unified long-format table (pep_all), and renders self-contained interactive HTML QC reports plus csv/xlsx/png result exports.

Mid-conversion to an R package (work-in-progress on the dev branch, rollback point tagged pre-package-v0): project-style-guide.md documents the target R-package + Docker + Shiny distribution pattern. The package layout is now primary — DESCRIPTION, LICENSE/LICENSE.md, NAMESPACE, R/ (the ~40 functions migrated from 00_functions.R, plus the report entry point), inst/rmarkdown/templates/ (the two Rmds, converted to package report templates), tests/testthat/ (hand-synthesized fixtures + a full testthat-edition-3 suite — loaders, annotation, checks, counting, io-export, overlap-counters, plotting smoke tests), .github/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml (Win+Ubuntu CI, green on dev), man/, _pkgdown.yml, .Rbuildignore — library(HowMaHiCo) (or devtools::load_all()) gives you everything; source()-ing files from 0_code/ is no longer part of the workflow. devtools::check() is clean (0 errors/0 warnings) as of the Phase-5 doc/check pass. The original 0_code/-based files (00_functions.R, 01_report_main_template.Rmd, 02_report_upsets.Rmd, 00_knit_reports.R, 00_extract_sample_info_fragpipe.R) still sit in the repo as the pre-migration reference copies — not deleted yet (Docker/Shiny/.bat distribution tiers remain — Phases 7-9 of the conversion plan — now that Phase 5’s tests/CI have landed), but no longer the canonical source: treat R//inst/ as authoritative and 0_code/ as legacy/about-to-be-removed (the “Directory layout”/“Key files” tables below still document that legacy 0_code/-based layout — rendering and the function library have already moved on, per “Pipeline / data flow” and “How to run” below; those two tables get a wholesale rewrite once 0_code/ itself is deleted in a later phase). RStudio project file: HowMaHiCo.Rproj. Tracked in a private GitHub repo (DavidGZ1/HowMaHiCo, remote origin); 2_data/, 3_results/, 4_figures/, and rendered *.html reports are gitignored (regenerated by the pipeline, kept out of version control to keep the repo small).

One vendoring note worth knowing up front: R/vendored-deltaprotr.R copies get_dirs_index_peaks() from the author’s other package, deltaProtR (github.com/DavidGZ1/deltaProtR) — verbatim-adapted, not Imports-declared, to avoid taking on a GitHub-only package dependency (would need Remotes: everywhere: CI/Docker/installs). It’s the only deltaProtR function HowMaHiCo actually calls (confirmed by grepping every deltaProtR::/bare-call site across 00_functions.R and both Rmds) — library(deltaProtR) still appears in 00_functions.R/the Rmds/ 00_extract_sample_info_fragpipe.R for now but is vestigial and will be deleted once the Rmds are converted to package templates.

Directory layout (numbered-folder convention)

Folder Contents
0_code/ All logic: shared functions, driver scripts, Rmd report templates
1_documentation/ Sample annotation CSVs (one per analysis subset)
2_data/ Raw search-engine output (FragPipe psm.tsv, DIA-NN report.tsv) + cached *_pep_all.rda
3_results/<subset>/ Per-subset csv + xlsx outputs (pep_all.csv, counts_pep_all_condition.csv, seq_by_condition.xlsx, …)
4_figures/ Optional PNG plot exports (only when PlotsSave = TRUE)
(repo root) Rendered reports: 01_report_main__hla1_<dda\|dia>_<all\|jy\|plasma>.html

Pipeline / data flow

LC-MS search output (FragPipe psm.tsv, DIA-NN report.tsv, PEAKS peptide.csv)
      │   read + parse + annotate  (software-specific loaders converge on one schema,
      │   exported from the HowMaHiCo package — library(HowMaHiCo))
      ▼
pep_all  — unified long-format table, cached as <FolderData>/<suffix>pep_all.rda
      │
      ▼
inst/rmarkdown/templates/howmahico-report/skeleton/skeleton.Rmd
      │   rendered via run_howmahico_report() → self-contained interactive HTML report
      │   (ID counts, overlaps, distributions, QC sections — see below)
      ▼
<FolderResults>/<subset>/*.csv, *.xlsx, input_params.csv
      +   <FolderFigures>/<subset>/*.png (optional)

howmahico-upsets (from 02_report_upsets.Rmd) is the secondary overlap/UpSet-only report template, rendered the same way with template = "howmahico-upsets".

Key files

  • 0_code/00_functions.R — the engine. Loads all libraries and defines ~40 functions:
    • Three software-specific loader families that each read one tool’s raw output and converge on the same pep_all schema (selected via the Software param):
      • fp_read_psm_batch / fp_parse_pep_all / fp_annotate — FragPipe psm.tsv
      • diann_read_tsv_batch / diann_parse_pep_all / diann_annotate — DIA-NN report.tsv
      • peaks_read_batch / read_pep_peaks — PEAKS peptide.csv
    • Shared helpers: read_annot, print_annot, check_file_exists, check_output_exists, count_ids, count_ids_condition_bylengthrange, get_charge_group, get_proportion_charge, get_mat_log2area, summarise_area, check_ids_global, list_sequences, count_ids_by
    • Plotting: plot_peplength(_dens), plot_pepmass, plot_pepmz, plot_venn4, plot_upset, ggseqlogo_bylength, plot_heatmap, plot_pca, plot_corr, plot_charge_proportions, plot_prop_length_condition, plot_violin_areacv, plus the shared theme_rawr ggplot theme and ggsave_rawr/ggprint_rawr wrappers
  • 0_code/01_report_main_template.Rmd (~1690 lines) — the main QC report. Section groups in order: total IDs (incl. decoys/contaminants) → ID counts (mean±sd, by length, by charge) → intra-condition replicate overlap (peptides/sequences/proteins) → cross-condition UpSet plots → pairwise overlap matrices → peptide size distribution (length/mass/m_z) → 2D ID distributions (RT × 1/k0 × m/z, “pseudochromatograms”) → log2(Area) Pearson correlation → Area %CV violin plots → identification QC (Score, mass error/ppm by condition & charge) → peptide motifs (seqlogo by length) → PTM profile → final export block (writes csv/xlsx, optionally png)
  • 0_code/02_report_upsets.Rmd — secondary report focused on overlap/UpSet plots (same params structure, narrower scope)
  • 0_code/00_knit_reports.R — the driver. First derives the _jy/_plasma annotation CSVs by filtering the _all annotation on Condition (run once), then calls rmarkdown::render() once per subset — 6 reports total ({dda,dia} × {all,jy,plasma})
  • 0_code/00_extract_sample_info_fragpipe.R — scans 2_data/ recursively for psm.tsv/report.tsv files and auto-generates skeleton annotation CSVs (get_annot_fp, get_annot_diann) into 1_documentation/sample_annotation_autogenerated_*.csv — a starting point you fill in (Condition, BioReplicate, etc. start blank)

Annotation file schema (1_documentation/sample_annotation_*.csv)

Required columns (checked by read_annot): - Condition, BioReplicate, TechReplicate, Sample — always required - Sample_fp (FragPipe/DIA-NN) or Sample_peaks (PEAKS) — at least one required; matches the data subfolder name (e.g. fragpipe_dda_combined/JY) - Source_file — required when mode = "combined_file" (FragPipe combined PSM, DIA-NN); matches the spectrum/run name within that subfolder - Sample_ID — free-text human-readable identifier

Matching key for joining annotation ↔︎ data: Sample_fp alone for fragpipe_dda_individual; Sample_fp + Source_file for combined_file mode and DIA-NN. read_annot also strips .d/.raw extensions from Source_file and replaces hyphens/spaces in Sample_peaks with underscores (matching PEAKS’ own export behavior). Factor order for all downstream plots/tables is taken from row order in the CSV (mutate(across(where(is.character), function(x) factor(x, levels = unique(x))))).

The pep_all schema

The unified long-format table every report section consumes (one row per peptide-sample observation). Core columns: Condition, BioReplicate, TechReplicate, Sample, Sample_ID, Accession/ProteinFirst/GeneFirst/ OrganismFirst, Peptide/Sequence/Length/Length_range, Score, Area/Log2Area, PTM, Charge/Nter/Cter, RT/invk0/Mass/ppm/m_z, Source_file/Source_File_ID/Precursor_Id, Found_By, PeptideID. pep_short is the subset filtered to Length within [ShortPeptideLenghtMin, ShortPeptideLenghtMax] (8–13 AAs for HLA-I, the biologically expected MHC-I ligand length window).

pep_all is cached to 2_data/<suffix>pep_all.rda (suffix = <Subset>_ or empty) so subsequent runs/inspection don’t require re-parsing the raw search files.

How to run

Render reports with library(HowMaHiCo) + run_howmahico_report() — a thin wrapper around rmarkdown::render() that locates the installed package’s report template via system.file() and knits it in a fresh environment (avoids a params-argument / rmarkdown::render()-injected-params name collision; see R/run-report.R). One call renders one report (composable — loop it for batch runs; Docker-idiomatic “one container run = one job”):

library(HowMaHiCo)
run_howmahico_report(
  template = "howmahico-report",        # or "howmahico-upsets"
  params = list(Title = "Report: MHC1p evaluation - dda_all",
                AnnotationFile = "sample_annotation_dda_all.csv",
                FolderDocumentation = "1_documentation",
                Subset = "dda_all",
                FolderData = "2_data", FolderResults = "3_results", FolderFigures = "4_figures",
                Software = "fragpipe_dda_combined", ...),
  output_file = "01_report_main__hla1_dda_all.html"
)

The 6-subset batch pattern that 0_code/00_knit_reports.R used to drive directly — deriving the _jy/_plasma annotation CSVs, then looping render() over {dda,dia} × {all,jy,plasma} — is preserved as a \dontrun{} example on run_howmahico_report/derive_filtered_annotation (R/run-report.R); the latter is the exported helper for the annotation-derivation preprocessing step (derive_filtered_annotation("sample_annotation_dda_all.csv", "1_documentation", "JY")).

Breaking change from the 0_code/-era reports — path params are now absolute (or relative to the render-time working directory; no longer assumed project-root-relative, since the template ships inside an installed package and can be rendered from anywhere). There’s also a new param, FolderDocumentation, that the legacy Rmds didn’t need (they hardcoded 1_documentation/):

Param Purpose
Software fragpipe_dda_combined | fragpipe_dda_individual | diann | peaks_xpro — selects the loader branch
Subset Subset name; becomes a filename prefix and a subfolder under FolderResults/FolderFigures
FolderDocumentation Absolute (or render-time-cwd-relative) path to the folder containing AnnotationFile
AnnotationFile CSV name within FolderDocumentation
FolderData / FolderResults / FolderFigures Absolute (or render-time-cwd-relative) paths for cached pep_all input / csv+xlsx output / png output
Instrument tims_tof | faims_orbi | orbi — controls ion-mobility (1/k0) handling
ShortPeptideLenghtMin/Max Defines pep_short window (8–13 for HLA-I)
PlotsInteractive TRUE = plotly widgets in HTML, FALSE = static ggplots
ResultsOverwrite FALSE makes check_output_exists/check_file_exists abort if outputs already exist
TestMode TRUE = load only first ~100 lines per file (fast iteration; can break correlation plots)
CsvSave / PlotsSave TRUE = also export intermediary csvs / png plots
TestStats Toggles ANOVA/t-test comparisons (currently mostly commented out in the template)

run_howmahico_report() always writes input_params.csv (package version + render timestamp + every param, long-format, via write_input_params()/write.csv_rawr()) into FolderResults, independent of CsvSave/PlotsSave — joining pep_all.csv, counts_pep_all_condition.csv, and seq_by_condition.xlsx in the “always written” export tier (see “Export tiers” below). The report header’s code-version line is now `r packageVersion("HowMaHiCo")` — reads from DESCRIPTION, can’t drift out of sync with a hand-typed string.

Dependencies are declared in DESCRIPTION (Imports/Suggests, per project-style-guide.md’s meta-package-free convention) rather than library()-ed at the top of a sourced script — deltaProtR is no longer one of them: the one function HowMaHiCo actually called from it (get_dirs_index_peaks) is vendored into R/vendored-deltaprotr.R.

Conventions & gotchas

  • Software drives everything downstream — the loader branch in the Rmd’s “Loading files” chunk dispatches on this string (grepl("fragpipe_dda", ...), == "diann", == "peaks_xpro"). Valid combined-vs-individual mode is inferred from whether "combined"/"individual" appears in the Software string.
  • FragPipe currently reads psm.tsv, not peptide-level results — this means FDR is applied only at the PSM level, not the peptide level (a warning() documents this explicitly in the template; treat FragPipe peptide counts with that caveat in mind).
  • DIA-NN: ppm is a hardcoded dummy (= 0) because DIA-NN doesn’t report a calculated m/z to derive mass error from. Mass itself is computed (from Precursor.Mz/Precursor.Charge via formula — not the calibrated/observed mass the other loaders use); the in-template warning() lumps both columns together as “missing… dummy”, which overstates the case for Mass — check diann_parse_pep_all directly if precision matters.
  • Instrument only changes loader behavior for PEAKS (read_pep_peaks): tims_tof parses the X1_k0_Range column directly into invk0; faims_orbi/orbi repurpose Compensation Voltage (CV) as a stand-in (“not fully supported yet” per inline comments/messages). The FragPipe (Ion_Mobility) and DIA-NN (IM) loaders map straight to invk0 regardless of Instrument.
  • Fixed — FolderFigures/FolderResult typos in the setup chunk (a copy-paste slip present in BOTH legacy Rmds, that would have sent ggsave_rawr PNG output into 3_results/<subset> instead of 4_figures/<subset>, and referenced the nonexistent params$FolderResult): 01_report_main_template.Rmd ~L86/L92/L98 was corrected first; 02_report_upsets.Rmd ~L78/L84/L90 had the same bug (FolderFigures <- params$FolderResults in both branches, check_output_exists(params$FolderResult, ...)) and was caught/fixed during the Phase-4 conversion. Both inst/rmarkdown/templates/*/skeleton/skeleton.Rmd now carry the corrected pattern.
  • Overwrite guards: check_file_exists / check_output_exists throw before rendering if target files already exist and ResultsOverwrite = FALSE — intentional, to prevent silently clobbering prior analysis runs.
  • Export tiers: pep_all.csv, counts_pep_all_condition.csv, and seq_by_condition.xlsx are always written; everything else (per-sample log2Area matrices, count summaries, upset tables, PNG plots) is gated behind CsvSave/PlotsSave.
  • Code version in the report header is now `r packageVersion("HowMaHiCo")` (was a literal “Code version: vYYYYMMDD” string in the legacy Rmds) — it tracks DESCRIPTION’s Version field automatically; bump that (and CLAUDE.md’s version line, per the style guide’s release checklist) when the template logic changes meaningfully, rather than hand-editing a version string in the Rmd.
  • For the longer-term packaging conventions (R package structure, Docker, Shiny app, CI/release process) this project is expected to follow once matured into a distributable tool, see project-style-guide.md.
